# Faith Construction One

> Faith Construction One is a licensed, insured, family-based construction and
> remodeling company serving Jacksonville and Northeast Florida, with 500+
> projects completed and a 5.0 rating. It also operates Faith Waste Solutions,
> a dumpster rental vertical.

## Company
- Name: Faith Construction One
- Location: 10777 Scott Mill Rd, Jacksonville, FL 32223
- Service area: Jacksonville and Northeast Florida (Ponte Vedra Beach,
  Fernandina Beach, St. Johns, Amelia Island, Atlantic/Neptune/Jacksonville Beach)
- Email: hello@faithconstructionone.com
- Website: https://www.faithconstructionone.com

## Construction & Remodeling
- Paver installation (driveways, patios, walkways, pool decks)
- Kitchen remodeling
- Bathroom remodeling
- Interior improvements / LVP flooring
- Outdoor living (travertine pool decks, artificial turf)
- Pages: /, /projects, /contact

## Faith Waste Solutions — Dumpster Rentals
- One 16-yard roll-off dumpster for cleanouts, remodels, construction, and
  demolition debris. Same-day delivery available.
- Pricing: Daily $250 (includes 1 ton disposal), Weekly $360, Monthly $450.
- Add-ons: $80/ton over the included weight, $30/extra day. Delivery free within
  30 miles of ZIP 32223; quoted beyond.
- Booking page (coming soon): /waste-solutions/schedule
- Page: /waste-solutions
